# CM: auto-expand button for this building; 20x20 instead of the type's 20x44 slot, which would overflow the beta's 60-high checkbox column
										cm_auto_expand_existing_building_button_pl = { size = { 20 20 } }
why: CM's per-building auto-expand button, next to vanilla's per-building auto-expand checkbox (beta: in the subsidize/close/auto-expand vbox)
vanilla's per-building auto-expand checkbox is hidden while CM is active
game 1.4.1: the build button follows BuildingItem.CanBuildAnyBuilding / AreBuildingsUnderConstruction; level numbers 40 -> 55 wide in their 55-wide slot (Río 04.10.26 carries 1.4.0's)
